boot_race_incident_2026_11_06.symptom: fleet fell to 0/9 during restart: nexus-news bootstrap persist POSTed to nexus-data:9001 before its HTTP listener was bound -> 'All connection attempts failed' -> RuntimeError 'could not persist asset_registry row: XAUUSD' -> run.py tore the fleet down
boot_race_incident_2026_11_06.root_cause: _post_data had exactly one attempt and no retry
boot_race_incident_2026_11_06.fix: services/nexus_news/fundamental/runtime.py _post_data: bounded retry 5 attempts x 2s on CONNECTION errors only; HTTP >=400 stays fail-fast
boot_race_incident_2026_11_06.tests: tests/test_news/test_fundamental_persist_retry.py — 7 cases (recover after 1/3/4 failed connects, 4xx not retried, persistent failure graceful False, missing secret disabled)

posix_orphan_incident_2026_11_06.symptom: run.py --stop freed python service ports but next-server survived as an orphan holding :3100 (twice in one hour), blocking every relaunch with 'Port conflicts' until a manual kill
posix_orphan_incident_2026_11_06.root_cause: POSIX children stayed in run.py's own process group and _kill_pid/shutdown signalled single pids only — npm wrapper SIGTERM never reached the node grandchild
posix_orphan_incident_2026_11_06.fix: run.py: (1) spawn_service/spawn_dashboard pass start_new_session=True on POSIX; (2) shutdown() uses os.killpg(SIGTERM) with SIGKILL escalation; (3) _kill_pid resolves pgid and kills the whole group (TERM then KILL)
posix_orphan_incident_2026_11_06.end_to_end_validation: run.py --stop on the live fleet freed ALL ports including :3100 with zero orphan processes — first clean stop since the defect appeared
posix_orphan_incident_2026_11_06.tests: tests/test_runner_safety.py +4 (posix session spawn, windows spawn unchanged, posix shutdown killpg, group-targeted _kill_pid)

quality_gates.playwright_live: 5/5 PASS on production build (console_errors=0) — CSP frame-ancestors breaks nothing
